src/ops/candidate_selector/bf16/candidat.reason: Part of the candidate selector's NVFP4 codebook support and its mixed-format guard. The guard's comment records the measurement: each codebook was validated on its own and the route is chosen from the predecessor alone, so an NVFP4 predecessor with a BF16 successor reached the NVFP4 kernel holding the successor's null scales pointer -- an illegal access 0x38AC into unmapped memory that aborts the process rather than failing the request, and the reverse reads packed E2M1 as bf16 and returns wrong drafts. Both codebooks come from one artifact in production, so requiring them to agree closes the hole at no cost. Blast radius: 4 callers including draft.cpp's propose_dflash2_batch; tests/ops/test_candidate_selector.cpp covers it.
